subject: [PATCH v3 4/4] mm/damon/core: use node counters instead of flushing the root memcg

2026-11-14.patch_summary: This patch modifies the damos_get_node_memcg_used_bp function to use node counters instead of flushing the root memcg's statistics when calculating LRU sizes. This change improves performance by avoiding unnecessary flushes and leveraging up-to-date node counter data for the root cgroup.
